title: VESPER Model Profile
description: REM-006 §4.3. Registration record for a model or credential. `cost_class` is mandatory and non-nullable, resolved AT REGISTRATION: a credential with no cost_class cannot be registered (INV-COST-4). This is the fixture type CI-022 was waiting on -- its absence is why CI-022 was moved back to PENDING during review. Authority: SR-001, SR-003, SR-005, SR-006, SR-009, SR-045, SR-056; REM-006, DF-PROVIDER-ADMIT.

cost_class.description: NON-NULLABLE. There is no default and no null: a profile without this field is invalid, so 'we forgot to classify it' cannot become 'it was treated as free'. INV-COST-4.

mechanism.description: How the cap is PROVEN, not asserted -- e.g. 'prepaid credit, no payment method on file'. A free tier on an account with a payment method attached can bill on overage.

hard_cap.description: INV-COST-5: metered_free_tier is treated as PAID absent a provable hard spend cap. See the allOf block -- without a provable cap the profile must declare `effective_cost_class: paid`.

effective_cost_class.description: What DF-PROVIDER-ADMIT actually gates on. Derived, not chosen: metered_free_tier collapses to `paid` unless hard_cap.provable is true. The two-field design exists so the collapse is visible in the record rather than buried in gateway code.

locality.description: SR-005's local fallback needs a machine-readable notion of local. `local` profiles remain admissible during FREE_TIME regardless of operating period, because they spend nothing.

capability_tier.description: SR-009 routing: difficulty-based selection between small and strong models. A tier, not a product name -- INV-HW-1 forbids product names in routing logic, and A-022 tests the routing behaviour rather than the model identity. `draft` exists for SR-056 speculative decoding, which remains R&D.

sustained_tokens_per_sec_min.description: MEASURED at enrollment, never declared (INV-HW-2). Null until SPIKE-001 supplies a measurement; a null here means 'not yet measured', and DF-SURVIVAL-PROFILE treats an unmeasured capability as unavailable rather than as available.

min_node_profile.description: The minimum NodeCapabilityProfile that can host this model. SR-057's 'fit in memory headroom, avoid swap' expressed as a profile constraint rather than as a product name.

credential_ref.description: Reference only. A credential VALUE never appears in a profile, in telemetry, in a checkpoint or in a model context (INV-OBS-1). Provider credentials are the highest-value target on the network.

error_taxonomy_version.description: GAP-022: retry-worthy / switch-worthy / fatal / content-policy. Versioned so that a provider changing its error semantics is a schema event rather than a silent behaviour change in the fallback ladder.

then.$comment: INV-COST-5 as a schema property. A metered_free_tier profile claiming effective_cost_class 'free' without a provable cap is INVALID -- the leak in the absolute FREE_TIME rule is closed at the type level, not at the call site.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: a default for cost_class, and any field naming a vendor or a product. Registration-time resolution is what makes the FREE_TIME prohibition absolute: by the time DF-PROVIDER-ADMIT runs there is no unclassified profile for it to guess about.
